overview: The Medford Bicycle Advisory Commission welcomed five new members, elected a new slate of officers, and reviewed planned bike infrastructure connecting Medford Square to the Green Line Extension. The commission also authorized purchasing additional bike light kits and discussed an upcoming helmet distribution event.

items.title: Remote Meeting Statement
items.summary: Denis MacDougall read the statutory statement authorizing remote commission meetings under extended COVID-19 provisions.

items.title: Roll Call and Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The commission called roll, welcomed five new members, and approved the previous meeting's minutes.

items.title: Announcements
items.summary: Members announced a 15-e-bike grant obtained by the Medford Housing Authority, an upcoming Bike to Work Day commuter convoy, and a People for Bikes city rating program.

items.title: Commission Orientation and Member Introductions
items.summary: Commissioners introduced themselves and reviewed the commission's ad hoc status, Open Meeting Law requirements, subcommittees, and inter-agency coordination.

items.title: Election of Commission Officers
items.summary: The commission elected Daniel Nuzzo-Mueller as secretary, Emily O'Brien as chair, and Bruce Kulik as vice chair.

items.title: Medford Square to GLX Bike Infrastructure Update
items.summary: Jared Powell reported that the Traffic Commission approved bike lanes and parking adjustments on Main Street, George Street, and College Avenue to connect Medford Square with the Green Line Extension station.

items.title: Bike Light Kit Distribution and Funding
items.summary: The commission authorized sending a thank-you letter to program sponsors and approved spending remaining fiscal year funds to purchase 240 additional bike light sets.

items.title: Helmet Distribution and Bike Rodeo Event
items.summary: Pat Bivens detailed plans for a helmet fitting and DIY bike rodeo scheduled for June 3, 2022, at Tufts Park in partnership with the Medford Recreation Center.
